data.long_description:
Peninsula Five | Signature Waterfront Living | Business Bay
  Peninsula Five by Select Group introduces an elevated level of luxury waterfront living along the Dubai Canal in Business Bay. Set within the prestigious Peninsula masterplan, it offers a blend of contemporary design, serene water views, and urban lifestyle, creating a standout residential address with exceptional community and leisure experiences.


  Features & Amenities:
  • Prime waterfront location with panoramic canal and skyline views
  • Swimming pool and dedicated leisure spaces
  • State‑of‑the‑art gym and wellness facilities
  • Children’s play area and family‑friendly zones
  • Elegant lobby and premium communal spaces
  • Restaurants, cafes, and retail outlets within the community
  • 24/7 security, concierge, covered parking, and EV charging
  • Landscaped gardens, jogging/cycling tracks, and sports courts for active lifestyles
  • Access to Peninsula Promenade and wider community amenities including parks and entertainment spaces
